_about: Recommended free and open-source software (PLAN.md §2.4). Download buttons go only to each project's official download page on its allow-listed domain; IT7Q never hosts binaries. tools/check.py enforces both. 'guide' is a slug from guides.json.

entries.name: Bitwarden
entries.what: A password manager that remembers every password for you and fills them in on your computer and phone.
entries.why: One strong password unlocks the rest, so you can use a different password everywhere without writing them down.

entries.name: LibreOffice
entries.what: A full office suite: documents, spreadsheets and presentations.
entries.why: Opens and saves Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, with no subscription to pay.

entries.name: OnlyOffice
entries.what: Office apps for documents, spreadsheets and presentations, with a look close to Microsoft Office.
entries.why: A good fit if you share a lot of Office files and want them to look the same on both ends.

entries.name: Thunderbird
entries.what: An email app for your computer that handles several mail accounts, contacts and calendars.
entries.why: All your email in one place, kept on your own computer rather than in someone else's app.

entries.name: GIMP
entries.what: A photo editor for retouching, cropping, resizing and touch-ups.
entries.why: Handles most everyday photo jobs without a monthly fee.

entries.name: Krita
entries.what: A painting and drawing app, made by artists for artists.
entries.why: Great brushes and drawing-tablet support, free for everyone, including kids learning to draw.

entries.name: Inkscape
entries.what: A design app for logos, flyers, signs and other artwork that stays sharp at any size.
entries.why: Make your own logo or flyer without paying for design software.

entries.name: darktable
entries.what: A photo workflow app for sorting and developing camera RAW photos.
entries.why: Lets photographers organise and edit big photo collections without a subscription.

entries.name: Joplin
entries.what: A note-taking app with notebooks, to-do lists and syncing between your devices.
entries.why: Your notes stay yours, and you can encrypt them before they sync.

entries.name: 7-Zip
entries.what: A small tool for opening and making zip files and other compressed archives.
entries.why: Opens almost any archive you're sent, and can password-protect the ones you send.

entries.name: Nextcloud
entries.what: Your own private cloud for files, photos, calendars and contacts.
entries.why: Dropbox-style syncing and sharing, with your files kept on a server you control.

entries.name: ClamAV
entries.why: A handy second opinion: scan downloads, USB sticks and shared folders for known nasties.

entries.name: Pi-hole
entries.what: A small network ad blocker that runs on a Raspberry Pi or a spare computer.
entries.why: Blocks ads and known tracking sites for every device on your home network at once.

entries.name: WireGuard
entries.what: A fast, modern VPN app for connecting safely to your home or office network.
entries.why: Reach your own files and devices securely when you're out, even on public Wi-Fi.

entries.name: Jitsi
entries.what: Video meetings that run in your browser or app, with no account needed.
entries.why: Send a link and talk face to face, without signing anyone up to anything.
